inbound: Existing single consumer retained. No getUpdates, setWebhook, Gateway, event subscription, slash registration or polling is created.

limits: No API-specific limit is guessed. Respect actual 429/Retry-After; unknown writes never replay. Binary maximum 10 MiB.

target proof on every execution
owner capabilities constrain actions
old token and space/target mismatch closed

durable write receipt and no uncertain replay
fixed CDN and bounded artifacts
